newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvia parliament gets 1997 budget plans.
newsitem.headline: Latvia parliament gets 1997 budget plans.

text.p: Latvia's parliamentary committees have started working on the government's draft of the 1997 balanced budget, the parliament press service said on Thursday.
The deficit-free budget is a key plank of the austerity policy pursued by Prime Minister Andris Shkele, who wants to balance the country's books after the deficit soared last year.
The deficit in 1995 rose to 90 million lats and the government wants to get it down to 40 million lats this year.
Cutting the deficit is a key part of Latvia's agreement with the International Monetary Fund (IMF), under which it was granted more credits. -- Riga Newsroom +371 7 22 66 93
